one_liner: Senior contracting job at the Pentagon's AI office: planning, negotiating, and overseeing contracts and Other Transaction Agreements for defense AI and data programs.
fit_summary: This GS-12/13-equivalent 1102 role requires a year of contracting officer or agreements officer work plus IT and AI acquisition knowledge. Daniel's IEM procurement and proposal work was contractor-side, so he likely won't qualify.
eligibility: Open to the public under Direct Hire Authority; veterans' preference does not apply.

Basic education requirement: a bachelor's degree plus 24 semester hours in accounting, business, finance, law, contracts, purchasing, economics, industrial management, marketing, quantitative methods, or organization and management. Transcripts are required.
Specialized experience: one year at the NH-2/GS-11 level performing Contracting Officer/Agreements Officer functions and applying IT/AI acquisition, IP, cybersecurity, and SCRM knowledge.
Security clearance: Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI), which requires a Top Secret-level investigation.
All requirements must be met by the November 4, 2026 closing date, on a resume of two pages or fewer that lists months and hours per week.
strategy: Skip it: the posting requires a year of contracting officer or agreements officer work, and his IEM proposal and purchasing work isn't contracting-officer experience.

A better use of his effort: entry-level GS-1102 contract specialist roles at GS-7/9 that are open to the public, or FEMA or Virginia VDEM program and policy roles that match his emergency management background.
resume_bullets: Found multimillion-dollar opportunities in SAM.gov, GovWin, BidPro and the DHS acquisition forecast, and led proposal writing (2019–2024).
Works with AI tools (Claude, Microsoft Copilot) alongside Microsoft Office, GovWin and SAM.gov.
interview_questions: Walk us through a contract or agreement you managed from requirement to closeout.
When would you use an Other Transaction Agreement instead of a FAR-based contract?
How would you address intellectual property and data rights when acquiring AI software?
Describe how you handled a contractor that was missing schedule or cost targets.
watch_outs: The posting requires Contracting Officer/Agreements Officer-level experience, which Daniel's known background does not show.
The degree and 24-semester-hour coursework requirement is mandatory, and transcripts must be submitted.
This is a public notice that may not result in a selection.
